Plugin.Name: VOZ_CRON
Plugin.Overview: Run and schedule your own scripts from the Unraid web UI. See every run at a glance with history, sparklines and live logs; organise scripts into folders; get notified on failures, repeated failures and recovery; set per-script exit-code rules, timeouts and overlap control. Custom cron schedules run exactly as Unraid reads them. Moving from User Scripts? Your scripts, schedules and settings are imported automatically on first install.
